paper.title_en: On locked states for damped driven Jaynes--Cummings equations
paper.abstract_en: We consider damped driven version of the Jaynes-Cummings equation which describes quantised one-mode Maxwell field coupled to a two-level molecule. The pumping and dissipation operator are polynomial in the creation and annihilation operators. The structure of the dissipation operator corresponds to the theory of completely positive trace preserving operators due to Lindblad, Kossakowski and others. We construct examples of {\it locked states} which are stationary states of the corresponding averaged dynamics in the interaction picture. The states are nonnegative Hermitian density operators with finite Hilbert-Schmidt norm. The calculations rely on the recurrence equation for diagonal entries.
